entries.additional_theorem: An independently written, machine-checked functional specification for each shipped P-256 kernel, tied to the named standard clause, so specification error is a checked property rather than an assumption.
entries.assumes: The functional specification itself is correct. A typo, a wrong constant or a wrong definition is invisible to the proof.
entries.proves: An instruction sequence satisfies a HOL Light Hoare triple relating it to a functional specification, over the object-code bytes the build produces.

entries.additional_theorem: A relational timing theorem for the exact compiled artefact under a declared leakage model, plus separately measured physical-channel evidence for the declared platform.
entries.assumes: Hardware executes those instructions in constant time (Hertzbleed-class and variable-latency instructions are excluded by assumption); DIT/DOITM help where present; power and frequency channels are out of scope.
entries.proves: The instruction sequence and all memory addresses are independent of secret inputs, and no variable-timing microarchitectural event occurs, under the model recorded in SOUNDNESS.md.

typing_rule: Every entry is classified and every external claim is UNVERIFIED with a settling method. this_project.state NONE means this project proves nothing for that dimension; BOUNDED_EVIDENCE means bounded observations exist that are not a proof. No entry claims to exceed the frontier.
